# RequestInput

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

data class [RequestInput](index.html)(val interruptId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = Uuid.random(), val message: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val payload: [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)? = null, val responseSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null)

A node's request for user input, which pauses the workflow until a matching response arrives.

Normalized into a long-running `adk_request_input` function call; the response is a [com.google.adk.kt.types.FunctionResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-function-response/index.html) with matching [interruptId](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-request-input/--root--.html).
